human_pressure.one_screen_brief: After 8076-8081, create the final production-backed baseline record for the current Ailuros governance evaluator: direct canonical producer acceptance, deterministic replay, idempotent import/rebuild, unknown-event preservation, two-sided scope conflict controls, cross-producer compatibility, and real regression corpus. This pack is documentation/acceptance only and must not hide unresolved failures.
human_pressure.why_now: The project needs a trustworthy stopping point where implemented governance claims are tied to repeatable production-backed evidence rather than pack completion status.
do_not_misread: Baseline freeze is not feature completeness.
Unproven frameworks, dimensions or transition classes remain explicitly unproven.

machine_core.goal: Publish a bounded evidence-backed baseline and stop speculative expansion until new production evidence arrives.
red_lines: Do not mark the baseline ready if any required predecessor remains todo due to a blocking correctness defect.
Do not convert unknown/unproven into supported.
Do not add roadmap capabilities merely to fill gaps.
invariants: Every baseline claim cites a completed proof pack/test/fixture.
Implemented, proven, partially proven and unproven are distinct statuses.
New work after this baseline requires new production evidence or a correctness defect.

producer.artifact: completed proof results from 8065-8081 and current repository validation

consumer.component: Ailuros engineering baseline and release-readiness documentation

observable_effect.assertion: Repository contains one explicit evidence-backed statement of what the governance runtime can and cannot currently claim.

proofs.assertion: All required predecessor proofs are complete or blocking gaps are explicitly recorded; full suite passes without code changes in this pack.

failure_semantics: Any unresolved correctness regression prevents a ready baseline and keeps this pack todo.
Evidence coverage gaps that are not correctness defects are recorded as unproven rather than failures.

steps.title: Verify predecessor evidence
details: Require evidence from 8065-8081 for direct raw acceptance, semantic projection, regression, source-neutrality, replay, idempotency, unknown preservation, conflict controls, producer matrix and corpus where those packs were applicable.

steps.title: Classify capability claims
details: For each canonical surface area mark implemented/proven/partially-proven/unproven and cite evidence.

steps.title: Record open gaps
details: Separate correctness defects from evidence-coverage gaps; do not invent fixes here.

steps.title: Re-run full validation
details: Run the repository full suite and record exact result.

steps.title: Freeze next-step rule
details: State that post-8082 semantic expansion requires new production evidence; correctness/conformance fixes remain allowed.

acceptance: Baseline claims are traceable to completed repository evidence.
No unresolved correctness defect is mislabeled ready.

must_check: 8065-8081 outcomes are represented accurately rather than inferred from filenames.
Every readiness claim has concrete evidence.
Correctness defects and coverage gaps are separated.
reject_if: A todo/failed predecessor is presented as proven without evidence.
Unknown or unproven areas are upgraded to supported.
Tests or production code are modified.
